records.note: Example Posti tracking link quoted in an open-source plugin's issue, not a confirmed shipment. The source attributes it to Posti, which no rule claims.

Published open-source tracking example. Posti returned history in a local live check on 2026-09-21 and in the canary until 2026-09-24; since 2026-09-25 it is past Posti's retention (zero hits, and Posti's tracker reports it as not found). Issuer-based number detection still selects PostNL.
Publicly reported shipment number; the attribution was not independently verified. The source attributes it to Posti; detection selects the generic postal carrier. US item inbound to Finland.
